title: Replay Capsule
user: A solo developer of a 2D browser game who needs a bug report that recreates the player's inputs and timing without operating a full analytics stack.
smallest_useful_product: NPM library to record pointer/key/gamepad events plus developer-supplied seed and checkpoints, then download/import a capped replay file.
success_measure: A sample Phaser/Kaplay demo reproduces 90% of seeded failures from a single imported capsule.
constraints: Explicit opt-in UI; never record text fields; strict size cap; browser API compatibility and gamepad timestamp caveats.
